description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90/3.05 each) capped at 19,999 based on ATK and MAG. Grants [Crystal Force Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode: Wedge (Wind)] to self. Grants [Attach Wind with Stacking].

description.name: Crystal Force I
description.text: 6 single hybrid attacks (2.00 or 6.60 each) capped at 19999, inflicts [Imperil Wind 10% (15s)], grants [Damage Cap +10000 2], [Quick Cast 2], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 2], and [200% ATB 1] to the user

description.name: Crystal Force II
description.text: 6 single hybrid attacks (2.00 or 6.60 each) capped at 19999, inflicts [Imperil Wind 10% (15s)], grants [Damage Cap +10000 2], [Quick Cast 2], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 2], and [200% ATB 1] to the user

description.name: Crystal Force Mode: Wedge (Wind)
description.text: Wind abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind abilities trigger 1 additional time, [DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)], removed if user hasn't Crystal Force Mode

description.name: DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)
description.text: Ignores 25% of the target's DEF and RES

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3
